description: This file contains shell scripting code for testing git replay functionality, including setting up repositories, performing rebases, cherry-picks, merge operations, and verifying their outcomes through assertions.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with a specified message.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Checks the number of lines in a given file or output.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes specified lines to a destination for comparison.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files or outputs.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that a command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Verifies that a command produces no output.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets or verifies configuration options for testing.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to execute after tests.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern within output for verification.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Simulates passage of time for operations like commits.
